about_section.description: Everest Education is one of the leading companies in enrolling international students in private universities and schools in Istanbul. We have a team of highly experienced and qualified academic advisors to provide you with specialized academic consultations.

partners.title: Turkish Universities We Are Proud to Partner With...
partners.blog_description: We look for news of organizations and useful topics for you in your educational journey, as it is coordinated, always full of everything that is useful and beneficial to you in our fields.

consultation.description: Book your online consultation now with one of our educational advisors via WhatsApp or Zoom so we can help you choose the most suitable university for you.

faq.description: If you don't find an answer to your question, do not hesitate to contact us via WhatsApp or call the numbers on the "Contact Us" page.
faq.q1: What is the goal of Everest Education?
faq.a1: We aim to provide the best educational opportunities for international students in Turkey...
faq.q2: Who is the Everest Education team?
faq.a2: The Everest Education team consists of academics, medical and engineering students, and consultants specializing in university admissions.
faq.a3: Leadership in the field of educational services and student consulting...
faq.a4: Because we provide integrated and completely free services to students...
faq.q5: What is the language of instruction in private universities in Turkey?
faq.a5: Study is available in both English and Turkish in most private universities.
faq.q6: How can I get a student visa for Turkey?
faq.a6: After obtaining university admission, you can apply to the Turkish embassy in your country with the required documents.
faq.q7: Can I work in Turkey after graduation?
faq.a7: Yes, Turkish law allows foreign graduates to obtain a work permit and work in Turkish companies.
faq.q8: Are student housing options available within the university?
faq.a8: Yes, most private universities provide excellent student housing inside or near the campus.
